label: VERIFIED
extraction: Claude Code MCP Tool Hooks: Type 'mcp_tool' calls a tool on already-connected MCP server. Tool's text output treated like command-hook stdout. Part of 5 hook types: command, prompt, agent, http, mcp_tool. MCP tool hooks receive mcp_server object in PermissionRequest hooks. Configured in settings.json hooks block. Enables deterministic integration with external MCP servers at lifecycle events. JSON input/output format same as command hooks but via JSON-RPC to MCP server.
